resumeText:
Rahul Deshmukh | Mumbai | rahul.deshmukh@example.com

SUMMARY
Operational risk manager with 11 years in banking operations and second-line risk.

EXPERIENCE
Operational Risk Manager, Western Coast Bank, Mumbai (2020 - present)
- Own the RCSA, loss data and KRI framework for retail and operations.
- Set KRI thresholds under the bank's risk appetite framework and escalate breaches.
- Implemented the RBI master direction requirements and guidance on operational resilience across operations.
- Oversee BCP testing for critical operations and review recovery results.
- Review outsourcing and vendor risk for collection agencies and IT vendors.
- Review results of internal controls testing from the first line and audit.
- Present operational risk to the risk management committee each quarter through board reporting packs.
- Managed a team of 5 operational risk analysts.
- Use stakeholder communication to challenge business heads on overdue actions.

Operations Risk Officer, Western Coast Bank, Mumbai (2015 - 2020)
- Investigated loss events and ran root-cause reviews.

EDUCATION
MBA Finance, Mumbai University, 2015
